_about: AI weights (SPEC §12.3, §17), map-level only (in-battle tactic and retreat weights come later). A field squad, when idle, scores holding the building it's on against moving to each neutral or player-held town, tower or temple (worth least, session 059) no other enemy squad is after (EnemyAI).
_refuge_types: User, 2026-11-13: an enemy squad that has lost go_home_fallen_share of its units (or its leader) falls back to the nearest building of these types the enemy holds with no hostile squad on it (the Enemy Base if none), and brings its fallen back there. Its fallen also come back while it stands still on any of them.

field._value: A building's worth: type_value × (1 + middle_weight × how central it is between the two bases, 0 at a base to 1 midway) × player_held if the player holds it.
field._hold: Holding: the value × (hold_base + threat_weight × min(1, player Threat within threat_radius ÷ the squad's own Threat)); 0 if another enemy squad already holds it.
field._move: Moving: the target's value ÷ (1 + distance ÷ distance_range), distance_range given for a 400-wide map, scaled up for wider maps (never down).
field._choice: The higher score wins logic_chance of the time; otherwise a coin flip between holding and the best move. A holding squad thinks again after rethink_ticks.
